featured_reviews.name: pritpal singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been donating to Nanhri Pari Foundation for a long time and have always contributed according to my financial capacity. While I genuinely appreciate the work they do, I am extremely disappointed with the recent experience.

For the last six months, I have been receiving repeated WhatsApp messages pressuring me to make “urgent” donations. This constant follow-up feels intrusive and uncomfortable. Donations should always be voluntary and made from the heart ,not solicited through repeated or forceful requests.

I truly hope the organisation reviews this approach. Respecting donors’ boundaries is essential for maintaining trust and long-term support. If the communication style does not improve, it becomes difficult for genuine supporters like me to continue contributing.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We provided social media management services to Nanhi Pari Foundation in good faith, but after partial payment and using the whole service , they ghosted us despite repeated reminders for the remaining payment. It’s disappointing when an NGO, which should uphold trust and integrity, exploits freelancers/small businesses.

If you’re working with them, ensure agreements are in writing. Transparency matters, especially for organisations claiming to drive social change. Hope they rectify this, as such behavior undermines their credibility.

featured_reviews.name: Eknath Chandrakant Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
ABOUT PRAJA

Praja is a non-partisan organisation working towards enabling accountable governance since 1999. Praja empowers citizens to participate in governance by providing knowledge and perspective so that they can become politically active and involved beyond the ballot box. It undertakes extensive research and highlights civic issues to build the awareness of, and mobilize action by the government and elected representatives (ERs).

THE PROBLEM

Praja believes that uninformed and disengaged ERs and administration, rather than existing systems or policies, are responsible for the lack of good governance. There is a paucity of tools to facilitate effective interaction between citizens and the local government.

PRAJA's RESPONSE

Praja conducts data driven research and provides information on civic issues to citizens, media, and government administration and works with ERs to identify and address inefficiencies in their work processes, bridge the information gaps, and help them in taking corrective measures.

HOW DID IT EVOLVE?

1999: Praja, along with the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC), created Mumbai's first Citizen Charter
2003: Teamed up with BMC and built its citizens' grievance redressal mechanism, the Online Complaint and Management System (OCMS), and conducted complaint audits in the ensuing years
2005: Published Mumbai Citizen's Handbook to demystify governance in Mumbai; About 2 lakh copies distributed
2008: Initiated Praja Dialogue; launched CityScan, an online collation of extensive data on civic and security Issues In Mumbai; Published councillor handbook; and annual report cards on MLAs, and councillors
2014: Conducted workshops with ERs, educating them on policies and roles; started the Delhi Chapter to replicate the model developed In Mumbai
2016: Launched MLA and Councillor Report Cards in Delhi

Masoom is a not for profit organization that works with the night school students to work on the academics and provide better career opportunities to them. Masoom began with informal research on the educational problem of night schools culminated in a action program in 2008. Masoom is the first organization in Maharashtra to run a comprehensive “School Transformation Programme” for night school education. Masoom started with 2 night schools in the first year and then gradually increased its spread to 47 schools and 3500 students in the year 2015. Masoom plans to reach out to 210 night schools by 2020 impacting 20,000 night school students in Maharashtra.

The ‘Night School Transformation Program’ is specifically tailored to meet the needs of the night school and the individual students who are mainly school dropouts from poor socio-economic background, most of them working during the day and supporting their families.. owner_posts.post_text: 🌍 Feeling inspired? So did Anjali from Mumbai! She shared how Prema Social Foundation’s environmental programs made her realize the power of small actions for a greener planet. 💚 PSF’s initiatives in education, animal care, and community building are changing lives across India. If you’re eager to make a real impact and be part of something bigger, come see what we’re all about—right here in Mumbai! Let’s create a compassionate, sustainable future together. Join us and be the change you want to see! 🌿✨
Prema Social Foundation is among the top non profit organizations in Mumbai, dedicated to educational development, food distribution, animal welfare, environmental, and women empowerment programs.
Prema Social Foundation is dedicated to animal welfare and supporting needy communities through food distribution, education, women empowerment, and environmental initiatives in Mumbai.

In India, 1 in 3 women face physical or sexual violence. At Prema Social Foundation, our Women Empowerment Programs aim to break this cycle by providing education, skills training, and community support to empower women. By breaking free from societal norms and expectations, we enable women to take charge of their lives and make a positive impact in their communities. Join us in empowering women and creating a more just society.

🌟 Unlock the Power of Learning! 🌟

Join us at Prema Social Foundation for our inspiring Educational Development event! 🎓✨ We're passionate about nurturing bright minds and shaping a better future for India’s youth. Whether you’re a student or a volunteer, your support can make a real difference.

Come see how we’re transforming lives through education support — because everyone deserves a chance to shine. Let’s create hope and opportunities together! 💙

Ready to be part of something meaningful? We’d love to see you there!

In Mumbai, 1 in 5 people struggle to access basic necessities. Our Food Distribution Programs for the Needy provide a lifeline, ensuring no one goes hungry. Support our mission to empower communities, one meal at a time, by considering a donation today.

At Prema Social Foundation, we believe that empowered women empower communities. Our Women Empowerment Programs in Mumbai focus on skill development, education, and job placement, helping women break the cycle of poverty and inequality. By supporting these initiatives, you can contribute to a more just and equitable society. Learn more about our programs and get involved today.

Every day, thousands of individuals in our community struggle to access basic necessities, including food. Food insecurity can have devastating effects on mental and physical health, as well as overall well-being. At Prema Social Foundation, our FOOD DISTRIBUTION PROGRAMS EVERY NEEDY aim to bridge this gap, providing essential sustenance to those who need it most.

In Mumbai, 1 in 5 children lack access to quality education, hindering their potential and societal growth. At Prema Social Foundation, we believe that education is the key to unlocking individual and collective prosperity. Join us in our mission to provide educational development opportunities to underprivileged children and empower them to build a brighter future.

Education is the key to unlocking human potential. In India, where education is a fundamental right, many children still lack access to quality educational resources. At Prema Social Foundation, we believe that every child deserves an opportunity to learn and grow. Support our mission to empower underprivileged children through educational development and help shape a brighter future for all.

name: Ekam Foundation Mumbai
description:
Ekam Foundation Mumbai is a registered Charitable Trust that has been working since 2012, to improve health and well-being of a child by providing aid to meet their healthcare and educational needs.
It has below four flagship programs;
Ø Surgery Support Program (SSP): It provides direct financial aid to underserved children needing critical medical treatment for their health and well-being. Since inception it has helped to save lives of more than 9000+ children across 23 States in India.
Ø Ekam Education Program (EEP): It provides support to needy children and young adults to complete their education for a better future. Since 2020, it has supported more than 3000+ students across 23 States in India.

Moneylife Foundation take pride in being fiercely independent, non-partisan and always pro-saver.
Moneylife Foundation runs two FREE helplines – relating to Credit and Borrowing and Legal issues, including property & CHS.

featured_reviews.review_text: I had an incredible experience with Tribes For Good! featured_reviews.name: Akshara Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Working with TribesForGood was an enriching expereince! My mentors were really supportive and I definitely learnt a lot. featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience working with TribesForGood. As a part of my program, I worked with various NGO's and helped uplift small businesses. The mentors were always supportive and were always available to provide guidance.  The program helped me improve my communication skills aiding me to connect with and help others, and create a social impact. It truly was an enriching experience.

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Kathe
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience with TribesForGood. They provided excellent support and guidance throughout my volunteering journey. The mentors were always available to help and answer my questions. I felt welcomed and grew personally and professionally. I made great friends with other volunteers. The programs were well-structured and made a positive impact in the community. I gained valuable skills and experiences. Thank you for the incredible volunteering journey!

featured_reviews.name: Jahnavi Baweja
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience with TribesForGood was enriching and I learnt many new things and experiences. Whether you are passionate about educating people, social justice for example gender inequality or even the climate, then TribesForGood provides a big platform where you can showcase your passion along with other like-minded people who are set out to achieve the same goal. Most importantly I acquired new skills and made a positive social impact. Personally, I enjoyed the fieldwork sessions where I could teach underprivileged youngsters about the importance of physical and mental health. I thing TribesForGood provided me with an amazing opportunity to give back to the society and my experience with them was incredible.

featured_reviews.name: Amogh Raghavendra
featured_reviews.review_text: TribesForGood is a wonderful organization that helps you make an impactful change to the world. TribesForGood sparks the inner leader in you, and helps you take initiative for a variety of projects, such as: online field work sessions, where you act as a mentor and teach children topics that suite your interests, and community projects, where you interact with a local institution to make a change. TribesForGood taught me important leadership skills during my field work sessions, and I had to apply those skills in the community projects. It was truly an amazing experience!

featured_reviews.name: Sanah Sehgal
featured_reviews.review_text: Whether you are passionate about education, the environment, or social justice, TribesForGood provides a platform for you to connect with like-minded individuals and create a positive impact together. By joining TribesForGood, I got the opportunity to gain valuable skills and experiences. It provided me with skills like leadership and project management, as well as the chance to collaborate with professionals during my fieldwork sessions and my community projects. This experience not only empowered me as a leader but also left a lasting impact on the communities we worked with.
